integrity: Exact definitions, quantifiers and asymptotic proof given; finite exhaustive checks reproducible. No claim of independent certification, authorship or definitive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Finite full-powerset tense algebras defined by permutations; fixed cycle length for asymptotic law. Primitive necklaces and ordinary distinguishing coloring principles are prior art, and a broader Poisson theorem may imply the result. Finite checker does not verify infinite asymptotics.
title: A two-obstruction Poisson law for generators of finite permutation tense algebras
